name: HyperDial
description_en:
HyperDial is a business cloud-communications platform combining browser calling,call routing and queues,recording,conversation analysis and AI voice agents. The voice product describes campaign lists,power and predictive pacing,live manager coaching and CRM write-back. Public documentation supports evaluating these workflows,but not treating the promised conversion uplift,uptime or automatic redaction as independently demonstrated results.

An illustrative outbound team would select a permitted calling plan,verify its number and contact permissions,load a campaign,set retry/pacing limits,and review the resulting disposition,recording and CRM update. Automated dialing and AI minutes have different commercial boundaries from ordinary manual calling. Several official pricing and trial statements conflict;those differences are preserved here. No account,number,call,AI training,port,CRM synchronization,purchase or export was executed.
description_zh:
HyperDial是企业云通信平台，结合浏览器电话、路由和队列、录音、会话分析及AI语音客服。语音产品描述活动名单、Power和预测拨号节奏、主管实时指导及CRM回写。公开资料可支持评估这些工作流，但不能将转化提升、可用性或自动脱敏承诺当作独立验证结果。

假设外呼团队会选择获准的通话方案、核对号码和联系权限、导入活动、设重试／节奏上限，再复核处置、录音及CRM更新。自动拨号和AI分钟的商业边界不同于普通手动电话。若干官方价格及试用表述冲突，本档案保留差异。未执行账户、号码、电话、AI训练、迁号、CRM同步、购买或导出。

core_features.explanation_en: Browser lists,retry rules,power/predictive pacing,and manager listen/whisper/barge are described for outbound operations.
core_features.explanation_zh: 外呼描述浏览器名单、重试规则、Power／预测节奏及主管监听／耳语／介入。

core_features.explanation_en: Recordings,transcripts,intent tags and scores use campaign retention and a selected playbook.
core_features.explanation_zh: 录音、转录、意图标签及评分按活动留存和所选话术手册运行。

core_features.explanation_en: Vendor describes learning patterns from customer recordings before manager approval and human escalation.
core_features.explanation_zh: 厂商描述从客户录音学习模式，经主管批准后运行，并可转人工。

core_features.explanation_en: Free Base has no subscription fee;number,usage,AI and dialer charges still require the selected contract and rate card.
core_features.explanation_zh: 免费Base无订阅费，号码、用量、AI及拨号器仍需核对所选合同和费率表。

en: An outbound business team piloting browser campaigns with explicit pacing,consent and CRM result checks.
A support operation assessing queues,recording retention and human escalation before adopting AI handling.
zh: 以明确节奏、联系许可及CRM结果检查试跑浏览器活动的企业外呼团队。
在采用AI处理前评估队列、录音留存及转人工的支持团队。
use_cases.basis: Editorial fit,not verified sales lift,call quality or compliance.

Browser and integration claims.en: Voice page describes a browser/headset workspace and two-way CRM synchronization every30seconds. No authenticated API contract,retry guarantee,connector permissions or complete export was tested.
Browser and integration claims.zh: 语音页描述浏览器／耳机工作区及每30秒双向CRM同步，未测试认证API契约、重试保证、连接器权限或完整导出。

steps.en: Confirm the region,seat commitment,permitted dialer/AI use,number documents,trial duration and complete carrier rate card before provisioning.
steps.zh: 开户前确认地区、席位承诺、获准拨号器／AI用法、号码文件、试用期及完整运营商费率表。

steps.en: Pilot one campaign with consent/suppression records,retry limits,recording notices and a tested human escalation path.
steps.zh: 用联系许可／屏蔽记录、重试上限、录音提示及已测转人工路径试跑一个活动。

steps.en: Compare the dialed result,CRM write-back,recording/transcript and invoice usage;test missing-agent and failed-write cases before scaling.
steps.zh: 比对拨号结果、CRM回写、录音／转录及账单用量，扩量前测试无客服及回写失败。

items.en: Pricing cards claim included calling,but the same page says minutes are never inside seat prices. Actual covered minutes and charges require confirmation.
items.zh: 价格卡称含通话，同页又称分钟永不包含座席价，真实包含分钟及费用需确认。

items.en: Pricing says7day/20minute trial;voice/help pages say14days and terms permit14days or another notified period. Actual offer is unresolved.
items.zh: 价格页称七天／20分钟，语音／帮助页称14天，条款允许14天或另告周期，真实方案未解决。

items.en: Manual unlimited allowances do not include predictive or AI-agent calls;contact-centre volume requires a suitable commercial scope.
items.zh: 手动无限额度不含预测或AI电话，联络中心流量需适当商业范围。

items.en: Automatic redaction may miss sensitive data and is explicitly not PCI DSS certification. AI scores and summaries may be inaccurate.
items.zh: 自动脱敏可能漏敏感资料，明确不是PCI DSS认证，AI分数和摘要也可能不准确。

items.en: The Getting Started collection contains only a password-reset article;complete provisioning and recovery instructions were not established there.
items.zh: Getting Started集合仅有密码重置文章，未在此建立完整开通及恢复说明。

license.notes_zh: 在期限及方案限制内授予非独占、不可转移、可撤销企业服务访问权，不是开源许可。

pricing.source_snapshot_zh: 美加USD实际界面：Starter年付折月15／月付20（最低两用户），Growth24／32，Business34／44，每用户／月，年付按年收。Enterprise按合同询价最低20–50。Base订阅0、不限用户，但号码／分钟付费。价格页七天20分钟免卡，与语音／帮助14天冲突。HyperAgent39／AI客服／月加0.22／分钟、首100免费；Parallel15／用户／月或180／账户／月，范围阈值需合同。含通话与同页全部分钟另计冲突。号码／运营商税费／AI另计，手动FUP排除预测／AI，未归一化全包成本。

faq.question_en: Does Base provide free phone calls indefinitely?
faq.answer_en: The subscription is zero,but numbers and minutes are charged. Terms allow the free plan to change or be withdrawn on7daysnotice and inactive accounts to close after90days with notice.
faq.answer_zh: 订阅为零，但号码及分钟收费。条款允许提前七天通知修改或撤销免费方案，对90天不活跃账户通知后关闭。

faq.question_en: Are the advertised uptime and redaction independently verified?
faq.question_zh: 宣传可用性及脱敏经过独立验证吗？
faq.answer_en: No. The voice page calls99.9%a paid-plan target,with contractual terms in the order form. Service terms say redaction may miss data and does not establish PCI certification.
faq.answer_zh: 没有。语音页将99.9%称为付费方案目标，合同条款在订单中；服务条款称脱敏可能漏资料，并不建立PCI认证。

official_check.scope: Public vendor documentation reviewed; no account execution, purchase, owner identity, independent review or publication approval.

review_notes: Vendor descriptions are documentation evidence, not independent reliability, usability or customer-outcome verification.
English and Chinese are paired drafts. Chinese text does not establish Chinese UI support.
All alternative relationships remain unreviewed. Public-web retrieval may use cached content; prices are dated observations.

sections.title_en: Follow the campaign through to a saved outcome
sections.title_zh: 跟踪活动直至结果保存
sections.en:
HyperDial’s voice page describes loading and segmenting campaign lists in a browser,choosing one-call-per-representative or predictive pacing,setting retry rules,and using local numbers or voicemail drops. Supervisors can listen,whisper or join;the intended result includes a disposition and CRM notes as well as the connected call. A browser and headset are described as sufficient agent equipment,subject to a stable network and the selected number/carrier configuration.

For an illustrative callback campaign,verify consent and suppression first,then test a live answer,a machine answer,a busy destination and no available representative. Predictive pacing can create abandonment risk even though the vendor describes slowing down as capacity falls. A dialer feature does not establish that its traffic is included in a manual-calling seat allowance. Number rotation to evade spam labels is prohibited by the published terms. No campaign or call was run.
sections.zh:
语音页描述在浏览器加载和分段活动名单，选择每客服一通或预测节奏，设重试规则，使用本地区号或留言投放。主管可监听、耳语或加入；预期结果除接通，还包括处置及CRM备注。客服设备称浏览器和耳机即可，但仍依赖稳定网络及所选号码／运营商配置。

以假设回拨活动为例，应先核对联系许可和屏蔽，再测试真人、答录机、忙线及无客服。虽然厂商称会随容量降低放慢节奏，预测仍有弃接风险。有拨号器功能不代表相应流量含在手动通话座席额度内，公开条款也禁止轮换号码逃避垃圾标签。未运行活动或电话。

sections.title_en: Review AI output and recording scope before relying on it
sections.title_zh: 依赖前复核AI输出及录音范围
sections.en:
The product describes recordings,transcripts,intent and objection tags,and scores against the playbook active when the call happened. The generic help FAQ describes learning a first playbook from around500recorded calls,with manager approval before customer-facing AI use and a transcript attached to human escalation. That number is vendor guidance,not a verified minimum or accuracy threshold. The Getting Started collection itself contains only a password-reset article,so it is not a complete deployment manual.

Service terms require review of AI output and warn that it can be inaccurate or incomplete. They also qualify automatic sensitive-data redaction:it may miss instances and is not PCI DSS certification. Recording retention is configured per campaign;deleting a recording also deletes derived transcripts and summaries,subject to backups. Test a failed escalation,an incorrect score and a redaction miss rather than treating automatic analysis as permission to make financial or employment decisions.
sections.zh:
产品描述录音、转录、意图及异议标签，并按电话发生时生效的话术手册评分。通用帮助FAQ称约500份录音可形成首版手册，经主管批准才对客户使用AI，转人工附转录。这个数量是厂商建议，不是已核最低量或准确率阈值；Getting Started集合本身只有密码重置文章，并非完整部署手册。

服务条款要求复核AI输出，并警告可能不准或不完整；还限定自动敏感资料脱敏可能漏检，不是PCI DSS认证。留存按活动配置，删录音也删派生转录和摘要，备份除外。应测试转接失败、错误分数及漏脱敏，不能将自动分析当作自动财务或人事决策权限。

sections.title_en: Observed prices are not a resolved all-in calling quote
sections.title_zh: 已观察价格不是已确定全包电话报价
sections.en:
The actual US/Canada USD pricing interface showed Starter15,Growth24and Business34per user per month with annual billing;switching to monthly showed20,32and44. Starter has a two-user minimum. Enterprise requests a contract with a20–50user minimum set by that contract. Base has no subscription charge and unlimited users,but number rental and minutes remain paid. These are dated public observations,not a checkout or negotiated quote.

The same page contradicts itself:cards promise included or unlimited calling while its embedded policy says numbers,minutes and messages are never inside a seat price. The legal FUP defines covered manual/click-to-call allowances separately. A buyer needs written destination,allowance and overage definitions before calculating costs. The pricing page’s7day,20minute,no-card trial also differs from14day wording on the voice/help pages and flexible14day wording in the terms. The applicable trial was not tested.
sections.zh:
实际美加USD界面在年付时显示Starter15、Growth24、Business34，每用户每月；切月付为20、32、44。Starter最低两用户，Enterprise按合同最低20–50用户。Base无订阅费且不限用户，但号码租金及分钟仍收费。这是有日期公开观察，不是结账或协商报价。

同页自相矛盾：卡片承诺包含或无限通话，内嵌规则又称号码、分钟和消息永不含座席价。法律FUP另定义手动／点击拨号额度。计算前需书面确认目的地、额度及超额费用。价格页七天20分钟免卡试用，也与语音／帮助14天及条款可另告周期的14天不同，未测试实际适用试用。

sections.title_en: Unlimited is scoped to people,shifts and permitted traffic
sections.title_zh: 无限受人员、班次及获准流量限制
sections.en:
The FUP defines normal unlimited use as one named person making live manual or click-to-call conversations,not shared logins across shifts. Its business-hours window is nine hours from first login,with occasional flexibility up to ten;activity beyond ten hours on more than three days in a month is treated as regular shared usage. Shift teams need a seat for each person. Predictive/multiline dialer calls,AI voice minutes,bulk/API messages and external forwarding legs are excluded from ordinary unlimited allowances or need separate scope.

Per-user allowances are said to pool across active paid seats and reset monthly without rollover. However,the example says ten Growth seats total30,000minutes while assuming10,000minutes per user;the arithmetic is inconsistent and no numeric allowance is derived here. The pricing page also caps attempts to one number at ten per hour and ordinary outbound concurrency at30%of account capacity. A Parallel Dialler add-on does not automatically settle all carrier or contact-centre charges.
sections.zh:
FUP将正常无限用法定义为一名具名用户进行真人手动／点击拨号会话，不是多班次共用登录。工作窗口从首次登录起九小时，偶尔可至十小时；每月超过三天活跃超十小时会被视为经常共享使用。每班每人需席位。预测／多线拨号、AI分钟、批量／API消息及转外部电话线路不含普通无限额度，或需独立范围。

称每用户额度按活跃付费席位汇总，每月重置不结转；但示例既称十个Growth席位总计30,000分钟，又假设每用户10,000分钟，算术不一致，本档案不据此推导数字额度。价格页还限同号码每小时十次尝试，普通外呼并发限账户容量30%；Parallel Dialler附加项不自动解决全部运营商或联络中心收费。

sections.title_en: Budget add-ons,call legs and the committed term
sections.title_zh: 预算附加项、电话线路及承诺期限
sections.en:
The pricing page separately lists HyperAgent AI39per agent/month plus0.22per minute with the first100minutes free,and Parallel Dialler15per user/month or an account-wide180monthly tier. Their thresholds and actual contract scope were not tested. Number rental,carrier registration/messages,taxes and custom integration remain separate items;WhatsApp no setup fee does not mean no message fee.

Terms round each answered call up to a full minute,including voicemail/PBX answers,and charge both legs of external forwarding. Prepaid credit ordinarily expires after12months or account closure and is non-refundable,subject to stated exceptions. Annual subscriptions commit for12months even if billed monthly,renew unless notice is given30days before expiry,and allow reductions at renewal. Fees are generally non-refundable with express breach/discontinuation exceptions. A port-out does not cancel the remaining subscription obligation.
sections.zh:
价格页另列HyperAgent AI每AI客服每月39加每分钟0.22、首100分钟免费，Parallel Dialler每用户每月15或全账户180月费档，未测试阈值和真实合同范围。号码租金、运营商注册／消息、税及定制集成另计；WhatsApp零开通费不是零消息费。

条款将每次接听向上按整分钟计费，含答录机／PBX接听，转外部电话两条线路均收费。预付余额通常12个月或关闭账户到期，除明确例外不可退。年订阅即使月付也承诺12个月，到期前30天未通知会续费，降量在续约生效。费用一般不退，存在违约／停服明确例外；迁出号码不取消剩余订阅义务。

sections.title_en: Export before leaving and distinguish storage from processing
sections.title_zh: 退出前导出，并区分存储与处理
sections.en:
Service terms grant limited business access rather than ownership of the platform or numbers. Port-out requires an active account and payment of undisputed fees;unported numbers may be released30days after account closure. Customer data can be exported through the dashboard or API while active,and an export can be requested within30days after closure;the terms describe deletion within90days afterward,with legal/billing and backup qualifications. Completeness and restoration were not tested.

Although the voice page says recordings stay in region,the terms describe primarily selected-region storage and permit some cross-border processing for routing/support. The99.9%uptime and sub-second outbound figures are explicitly targets,not measured historical performance;contractual uptime terms belong in the order form. HyperDial is an editorial candidate for a supervised communications pilot once billing and dialer scope are resolved. It is not yet evidence of a predictable all-in high-volume price,fully local processing or a proven portable archive.
sections.zh:
服务条款授予有限企业访问权，不转移平台或号码所有权。迁出需账户活跃且无未付无争议费用，关闭30天后未迁号码可能释放。账户活跃时可用后台或API导出，关闭后30天内可申请导出，之后90天内删除，依法／计费留存和备份除外；未测试完整性及恢复。

虽然语音页称录音留地区内，条款描述主要存储在所选地区，并允许路由／支持部分跨境处理。99.9%可用性及亚秒外呼数字明确为目标，不是历史实测，合同可用性在订单中。编辑判断在解决计费及拨号范围后可作有人监督通信试跑候选，尚不能证明高流量全包价格可预测、全部本地处理或可携档案可靠。

research_gaps.zh: 未测试账户／电话／号码／迁号／AI训练／CRM／API／购买／导出。含分钟与全部用量另计冲突、七／14天试用、错误汇总算例、真实地区／运营商费率、附加上限、连接器契约、完整退出导出、处理方、界面语言及SLA未核。主页普通HTTPS断连，使用成功产品／价格／法律页面，未绕TLS。厂商法律合规主张不是独立法律判断。
